name: hcapp_processThirdPartyLogin
description: Handles OAuth login (Facebook, Apple, Google). Resolves an existing Hasher by thirdPartyUserId, email, or thirdPartyEmail — updating OAuth tokens if found. Creates a new Hasher if none match. For new users, creates a HasherKennelMap record for a hardcoded 'FILTH Leiden' kennel (development artifact). Returns the hasher profile on success. Non-standard auth error format. Token validated against DeviceSecret + UPPER(userId).

parameters.name: hashersUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Accepted but not used in this SP (no sync delegate call).

parameters.name: photo
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(2000) vs Hasher.Photo NVARCHAR(1000) — could truncate.

parameters.name: thirdPartyAccessTokenExpires
parameters.description: Token expiry as string. Default '1/1/2100'. Cast to DATETIMEOFFSET — brittle.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(150) cast to DATETIMEOFFSET — no error handling on invalid formats.

parameters.name: includeInGlobalHashDirectory
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (don't update). Forced to 0 on update path.

parameters.name: hcVersion
parameters.description: App version. Used in ErrorLog inserts.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Used for USA miles detection. Default 0.

parameters.name: thirdPartyEmail
parameters.description: Email as reported by the OAuth provider (may differ from @email).

rowsets.name: UserNotCreatedError
rowsets.description: Returned when a final SELECT by thirdPartyUserId/email finds no matching hasher after all insert/update operations. Standard error format. errorTitle is wrong ('Reset code not found').

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Always 5 — wrong code for this scenario.

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: Always 'Reset code not found' — wrong error title for a user-creation failure.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: User message about reset code not found — also wrong.

rowsets.name: HasherProfile
rowsets.description: Returned on success. Subset of hasher fields — notably missing some fields returned by hcapp_authorizeDevice (e.g. no deviceSecret, no homeKennelId).

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Hasher.updatedAt cast via CONVERT(nvarchar(50), cast(updatedAt as datetime2)) — local time, no timezone.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher — sets OAuth fields when existing user found by thirdPartyUserId/email/thirdPartyEmail
UPDATE HC.Hasher — second update pass for photo, removed=0, etc.
INSERT HC.Hasher — when no existing user found
INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap — for 'FILTH Leiden' kennel if it exists (new users only)
UPDATE HC.Kennel SET KennelFacebookToken — when thirdPartyLoginType='facebook'

codeSmells.detail: Should be UNIQUEIDENTIFIER to match Device.id.

codeSmells.issue: Hardcoded 'FILTH Leiden' kennel as default follow for new users
codeSmells.detail: New users are automatically followed to a kennel matching 'KennelName LIKE %FILTH% AND CityName LIKE %Leiden%'. This is a development artifact from the project's origin that should not exist in production code.

codeSmells.issue: Wrong errorTitle and errorType for user-creation failure
codeSmells.detail: The error rowset returned when the post-create SELECT finds no user says errorType=5 and errorTitle='Reset code not found'. Both are wrong — this is a user-creation failure that should be errorType=5 (unhandled) with a meaningful title.

codeSmells.issue: Multiple UPDATE passes for the same user record
codeSmells.detail: The SP performs two separate UPDATE HC.Hasher passes (first updating OAuth fields, then checking again and updating a second set). Both run outside a transaction.

@firstName/@lastName/@hashName/@email NVARCHAR(120) vs Hasher NVARCHAR(250). @photo NVARCHAR(2000) vs Hasher.Photo NVARCHAR(1000) — photo could be silently truncated. @thirdPartyEmail NVARCHAR(120) vs NVARCHAR(250).
No TRY_CAST or error handling. Invalid date strings will crash the SP.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
